sections.title: 三、听力理解 (第一段对话)

audio.text: Daniel: Hi, Lucy. Do you often collect old boxes and bottles at home? Lucy: Sure. They are still useful in many ways. Daniel: And our teacher told us to make new inventions with old things. Lucy: Really? I made a collecting box with old gift boxes last week. Daniel: Wow, nice work! How this small invention helps you? Lucy: It keeps my socks tidy. It's green and creative.

questions.prompt: What small invention did Lucy make?
options: A paper bag.
A collecting box.
A pencil.
questions.translation: 露西做了什么小发明？- 一个收集盒。
questions.explanation: 根据对话“I made a collecting box with old gift boxes last week.”得出。

questions.prompt: What can we know from the dialogue?
options: Old things can be reused to make useful inventions.
Students must make inventions every week.
Old boxes are useless in daily life.
questions.translation: 我们从对话中能了解到什么？- 旧东西可以重复使用来制作有用的发明。
questions.explanation: 根据对话主题“make new inventions with old things”得出。

sections.title: 四、听力理解 (第二段对话)

audio.text: Grace: Henry, our school will hold a small invention show next month. Are you excited? Henry: Yes! I want to make a special thing to protect our school environment. Grace: Cool! What idea do you have in mind? Henry: I plan to use bottle caps and some sticks to make a rubbish picker. Grace: That sounds great. Why do you want to make this? Henry: It's easy to make, and it can help us clean our playground easily. Grace: See, small inventions can solve big problems in our lives, right? Henry: Exactly. Waste can be useful again.

questions.prompt: What will Henry make for the invention show?
options: A toy stick.
A rubbish picker.
A beautiful cloth bag.
questions.translation: 亨利为发明展会做什么？- 一个垃圾捡拾器。
questions.explanation: 根据“I plan to use bottle caps and some sticks to make a rubbish picker.”得出。

questions.prompt: What is Henry's purpose(目的)of making the invention?
options: To win big prizes at the show.
To help keep the school clean.
To use up some old things at home.
questions.translation: 亨利制作这个发明的目的是什么？- 帮助保持学校清洁。
questions.explanation: 根据“it can help us clean our playground easily”得出。

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the dialogue?
options: Small creative inventions can help in our daily life.
Students can make money by selling inventions.
The school asks students to make new things.
questions.translation: 对话的主旨是什么？- 小巧有创意的发明能在日常生活中提供帮助。
questions.explanation: 根据“small inventions can solve big problems in our lives”得出。

audio.text: Long ago, people dreamed of flying in the sky like birds. Two brothers, Wilbur Wright and Orville Wright, loved studying flying. They watched birds carefully and read many books about science. They tried many times and made many flying models. In 1903, they invented the first real plane. On a cold winter day, their plane flew in the sky for the first time. Soon later, this great invention changed the whole world. Planes help people travel far away in a short time. They also carry food, clothes and other things to different places. Today, flying is a fast and safe way of travelling.

questions.prompt: Only the Wright brothers wanted to fly like birds.
questions.translation: 只有莱特兄弟想要像鸟儿一样飞翔。
questions.explanation: 原文提到“Long ago, people dreamed of flying in the sky like birds”，说明不仅是莱特兄弟有这个梦想。

questions.prompt: The brothers learnt flying only from their teachers.
questions.translation: 兄弟俩只从他们的老师那里学习飞行。
questions.explanation: 原文提到他们“watched birds carefully and read many books about science”，并非只向老师学习。

questions.prompt: The first real plane was invented in 1903.
questions.translation: 第一架真正的飞机是在1903年被发明的。
questions.explanation: 与原文“In 1903, they invented the first real plane.”一致。

questions.prompt: Planes can carry people but can't carry other things.
questions.translation: 飞机可以载人但不能载其他东西。
questions.explanation: 原文说“They also carry food, clothes and other things to different places.”。

questions.prompt: The plane is a fast and safe way to travel now.
questions.translation: 现在飞机是一种快速且安全的出行方式。
questions.explanation: 与原文“Today, flying is a fast and safe way of travelling.”一致。

audio.text: Hello everyone. My name is Justine, J-U-S-T-I-N-E, Justine. I'm from Class Fifteen, Grade Six. I'm happy to show you my little invention. This is my desk rubbish bag. These are my materials: cardboard, strings and tape. First, I folded the cardboard into a box. Next, I stuck strings on both sides with tape. Last, I put it up beside my desk. Now I can put my waste paper in it right away, instead of letting it fall on the floor. I hope you can have one! Thank you!

sections.title: 十二、阅读下面的四张“发明家信息卡”判断正误
sections.passage:
# Four Inventor Information Cards

### 🌾 Yuan Longping
* **His Invention:** Hybrid rice (杂交水稻)
* **Time:** 1973
* **Use:** It produces (产出) much more rice than common rice. It helps feed lots of people and reduces hunger greatly in many countries around the world.

### 🌿 Tu Youyou
* **Her Invention:** Artemisinin (青蒿素)
* **Time:** 1972
* **Use:** It is a great medicine to treat malaria (疟疾). It saves millions of sick people's lives in poor countries.

### 🧪 Hou Debang
* **His Invention:** Hou's Process for Soda Ash (侯氏制碱法)
* **Time:** 1943
* **Use:** It can help make soda ash cheaply and in an environmentally friendly way. Soda ash can be used in many things like paper and soap. It helps China's chemical industry(化学工业) grow quickly.

### 🖨️ Wang Xuan
* **His Invention:** Chinese Laser Typesetting System(汉字激光照排系统)
* **Time:** 1979
* **Use:** It makes printing Chinese books fast and easy. It helps Chinese printing say goodbye to heavy lead printing type (沉重的铅字).

questions.prompt: Yuan Longping made hybrid rice in 1972 for malaria.
questions.translation: 袁隆平在1972年为了治疗疟疾制造了杂交水稻。
questions.explanation: 根据信息卡，杂交水稻是1973年发明的，用途是解决饥饿问题；青蒿素才是1972年发明用于治疗疟疾的，故错误(F)。

questions.prompt: Artemisinin saves sick people's lives in poor countries.
questions.translation: 青蒿素拯救了贫困国家生病人们的生命。
questions.explanation: 根据信息卡“It saves millions of sick people's lives in poor countries.”可知正确(T)。

questions.prompt: Hou Debang's work brought people with nice books.
questions.translation: 侯德榜的工作给人们带来了精美的书籍。
questions.explanation: 根据信息卡，侯德榜发明的是侯氏制碱法；王选的汉字激光照排系统才促进了书籍印刷，故错误(F)。

questions.prompt: Wang Xuan finished his printing tool in 1943.
questions.translation: 王选在1943年完成了他的印刷工具。
questions.explanation: 根据信息卡，王选发明汉字激光照排系统的时间是1979年，1943年是侯氏制碱法，故错误(F)。

questions.prompt: Three of these inventions appeared after the year 1970.
questions.translation: 这些发明中有三项出现在1970年之后。
questions.explanation: 袁隆平杂交水稻(1973)、屠呦呦青蒿素(1972)、王选汉字激光照排(1979)均在1970年之后，共3项，故正确(T)。

sections.title: 十三、阅读趣味发明的故事选择正确选项 (A)
sections.passage:
# Fun Stories of Inventions

| Inventions | Time | Inventor | The story in short |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Post-it Notes (便利贴) | 1968–1974 | Silver & Fry | In 1968, Silver made weak(粘性较弱的) glue by accident. In 1974, Fry used it to make sticky bookmarks, and then post-it notes were born. |
| Ball Pen (圆珠笔) | 1938 | Biro | Biro didn't like leaky (漏水的) pens. So he designed a small metal ball at the pen tip (尖端) to make ink come out smoothly and dry fast. |
| Band-Aid (创可贴) | 1920 | Dickson | His wife often cut fingers while cooking. He put small pieces of gauze (纱布) on long tape, so people could use it anytime easily. |
| Popsicle (冰棍) | 1905 | Frank (an 11-year-old boy) | He left soda water with a stick outside overnight. It froze (冻结) and turned into a tasty frozen snack. |
| Chips (薯片) | 1853 | Crum (a chef) | A customer complained potato slices were too thick. The chef cut potatoes very thin, fried them until they were crispy, and people loved them. |

questions.prompt: What is the same about all these five inventions?
options: They were all invented by children.
They all came from accidents or life problems.
They were all made in the same year.
questions.translation: 这五项发明有什么共同之处？
questions.explanation: 根据表格故事，便利贴、冰棍源于意外事故，圆珠笔、创可贴、薯片源于解决生活中的小困扰/问题，故选B。

questions.prompt: Why did the weak glue become useful at last?
options: People loved weak glue from the start.
An inventor found its special use.
It became stronger as time went by.
questions.translation: 为什么这种粘性弱的胶水最终变得有用了？
questions.explanation: 根据“In 1974, Fry used it to make sticky bookmarks...”可知，发明家发现了其特殊用途，故选B。

questions.prompt: Which invention was made for people's small cuts?
options: Band-Aid
Potato chips
Popsicle
questions.translation: 哪项发明是为了人们的小伤口而制作的？
questions.explanation: 根据Band-Aid部分“His wife often cut fingers while cooking...”可知创可贴用于小割伤，故选A。

questions.prompt: We can infer that great inventors are usually ______.
options: lazy and careless
careful and thoughtful
quiet and shy
questions.translation: 我们可以推断伟大的发明家通常是……
questions.explanation: 伟大的发明家善于观察生活、细心且深思熟虑(careful and thoughtful)，故选B。

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the whole passage?
options: All mistakes will bring bad things.
We only need big ideas to invent things.
Accidents and careful thinking can create great inventions.
questions.translation: 整篇短文的主旨是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文通过5个生动的小故事说明意外与认真思考能创造伟大的发明，故选C。

sections.title: 十四、阅读马钧发明水车的故事选择正确选项 (B)
sections.passage:
# The Story of Ma Jun's Waterwheel

Ma Jun was a great inventor in ancient China. One day, he saw farmers carrying water to fields with heavy buckets (水桶). They were so tired that they could hardly rest. This gave him a great idea—he wanted to make a tool to help farmers.

First, Ma Jun started to watch carefully. He went to the fields every day and looked at how farmers worked, and found all their troubles. He never stopped thinking about how to solve the problem.

Then, he studied hard to learn more. He read many old books about tools, and learned useful skills to make his idea come true.

After that, Ma Jun began to test again and again. He made many models, but they all didn't work. He never gave up. He corrected his mistakes and kept trying day after day.

At last, he made the wonderful waterwheel. It helped farmers greatly for a very long time.

questions.prompt: Why did Ma Jun want to invent a new tool?
options: He wanted to become famous.
He wanted to help the tired farmers.
He liked making tools for fun.
questions.translation: 马钧为什么想发明一种新工具？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“he wanted to make a tool to help farmers”可知他是为了帮助劳累的农民，选B。

questions.prompt: What is the correct order of Ma Jun's invention process?
options: get an idea → watch carefully → study hard → do tests
study hard → get an idea → do tests → watch carefully
watch carefully → do tests → get an idea → study hard
questions.translation: 马钧发明过程的正确顺序是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文中的连接词：This gave him a great idea → First, watch carefully → Then, studied hard → After that, began to test可知顺序为A。

questions.prompt: What can we infer about Ma Jun from the passage?
options: He was lazy and gave up easily.
He was thoughtful and persistent (坚持).
He only liked reading old books.
questions.translation: 我们能从文章中推断出关于马钧的什么？
questions.explanation: 马钧为农民着想(thoughtful)且面对失败永不放弃、不断尝试(persistent)，故选B。

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the whole passage?
options: How farmers worked in ancient China.
The life story of ancient Chinese farmers.
How Ma Jun invented the waterwheel with good spirits.
questions.translation: 整篇短文的主旨是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章详细讲述了马钧以良好品质和精神发明水车的全过程，故选C。

questions.prompt: What does the writer want to tell us?
options: Inventing things is very easy for everyone.
Great inventions come from good ideas and hard work.
We only need to read books to be clever.
questions.translation: 作者想告诉我们什么道理？
questions.explanation: 通过马钧的故事告诉我们：伟大的发明来源于好的想法与辛勤努力(good ideas and hard work)，故选B。
